text:
tara: Quick sync — need alignment on PRD for quotas & billing UI/API before sprint planning. Customers are asking for per-tenant bursts, per-model caps, and clearer metering semantics. Primary questions: (1) billing semantics (per-token vs per-request for streaming & function calls), (2) headers & retry semantics, (3) console surface + launch acceptance. Can we decide scope?

alex: @tara I can draft the API spec. Proposal summary: metering stays per-token for generation (including streaming), embeddings billed per-embedding unit, reranking/reranks billed per-call. For streaming, we bill tokens the server attempted to generate (not what the client consumed). Will emit headers for visibility. Example headers:```\nx-rate-limit-limit: 120000\nx-rate-limit-remaining: 119240\nx-rate-limit-reset: 1745015400\nx-estimated-tokens: 42\n```
Also add `x-quota-scope: tenant:abc123` so UI can aggregate.

maria: Billing notes: agree on server-side attempted tokens. Important edge-case: client disconnects mid-stream — we still must bill for compute used. For function-calls, include model prompt tokens + function args tokens + generated tokens. Cache behavior: if result is served entirely from persistent cache, bill a reduced cache-hit token rate (TBD), but we need deterministic logs for invoicing. Pricing semantics: free tier 100k tokens/month, metered per-1k tokens after that; committed tiers get committed discounts. Need rounding rules and currency handling in ACs.

sam: UI thoughts: keep it simple on launch: show "Usage this period", "Current quota", and a "Projected overage" if usage continues. For limits, show two lines: "Soft limit (warning)" and "Hard limit (enforced)" with toggles for email/Slack alerts. For per-model caps, offer an advanced panel — don't block MVP.

tara: Draft acceptance criteria (ACs) — put in PRD: 
- AC1: API returns throttle and quota headers for every response (`x-rate-limit-*`, `x-quota-scope`).
- AC2: Billing events contain deterministic per-request token delta (server-side attempted tokens).
- AC3: Console shows current usage, quota, projection, and allows alerting (email/Slack).
- AC4: Soft throttle behavior: allow configured burst window; after burst, clients receive 429 with `Retry-After`. Hard cap results in immediate 403-like error with clear message and link to upgrade.
- AC5: Migration: existing customers get 30-day notice and can opt into committed pricing; billing smoke tests with 3 pilot customers before GA.

alex: Implementation notes / edge-cases: runtime will implement token counting in the serving runtime to avoid double-counting between router + shard. We'll emit a single canonical `tokens_charged` field in billing logs. Throttling strategy: token-bucket per-tenant + per-model overrides. Soft throttle = 429 + `Retry-After` + `x-rl-backoff-recommendation`. Hard enforcement = 403 with `x-rl-enforced: true`. Need small SDK updates to surface headers and standardized retry logic example. Example retry pseudocode:```\nif (res.status === 429) {\n  wait(parseInt(res.headers['retry-after']) * 1000)\n  retry()\n}\n```
Also flag: streaming clients should not auto-retry the whole request for partial streams (we recommend resumable sessions or restart from last-assigned prompt).

maria: On pricing rollout: require billing team sign-off for rounding and invoice format. Must support retroactive adjustments for migration windows (credits). Also confirm tax & currency handling for enterprise contracts. We also need a clear overage plan: auto-block, auto-bill, or manual approval. For GA, prefer email alert + soft grace (7 days) before hard block for non-enterprise.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deployed quota-service/v2 to staging (build 2026.04.12-rc). Logs: https://staging-logs/redwood/quota/v2 (only for infra).

sam: mockups uploaded: https://figma.com/file/xyz/quota-ui (links in thread). Small UX ask: when we show projected overage, include a "What-if" slider for rate changes.

tara: OK — plan: @alex create PRD stub by EOD with the ACs above, API header spec, and proposed SDK retry snippet. @maria please confirm billing rounding/overage policy by EOW. @sam I'll add mockups to PRD. After that we schedule a quick RFC review with eng + billing next Tue.

alex: noted, will post PRD stub + Swagger example.

maria: noted, will validate billing edge cases and add test customers.

tara: thanks all. :thumbsup:
